requirements.quote: 10+ years of experience in infrastructure, platform, or systems engineering, with 3+ years leading infrastructure teams across multiple technical disciplines
Active U.S. security clearance, such as Secret, Top Secret or TS/SCI clearance
Deep hands-on expertise in Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GovCloud variants) at production scale
Working knowledge of networking across complex environments: multi-cloud, on-premises, VPNs, firewalls, and network segmentation across classification boundaries
Direct experience building or operating DoD accredited environments (IL-4/IL-5 or higher), with familiarity with NIST 800-53, STIGs, RMF, and the ATO process
Experience with CI/CD platform design and infrastructure-as-code practices at scale (Terraform, Ansible, or similar)
Active U.S. Secret clearance required; Top Secret preferred; must be able to obtain TS/SCI

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
Experience in aerospace, defense, or national security technology companies where infrastructure spans classification levels
Experience with service mesh (Istio, Linkerd), GitOps workflows, and developer platform tooling

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Digital Engineering | True Anomaly

requirements.quote: 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record shipping and operating production applications and services.
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. (US Citizenship is required to qualify for a security clearance)
Experience building user-facing web applications end to end — from data model and APIs to a modern front end (e.g., TypeScript, React).
Solid experience with API design, relational data modeling, and reliably moving data between systems.
Experience leading a project or feature area from design through delivery.
Experience operating software in production, including monitoring, debugging, and incident response.
Cloud fluency (e.g., AWS) and working knowledge of CI/CD and security fundamentals.
Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages (e.g., Go, Python, TypeScript).
Clear written communication, including technical design documents.
U.S. Citizen or lawful permanent resident (U.S. Person) as required under ITAR.
Experience with event-driven architectures and system-integration patterns.
Experience building, extending, or integrating PLM, ERP, manufacturing execution (MES), requirements/ALM, or MBSE systems.
Experience with versioned, auditable records and end-to-end traceability.
Experience migrating users and data from an off-the-shelf system to in-house software.
Strong product sense and experience working directly with engineering, manufacturing, or operations users.
Experience with Go, infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform), and GitOps.
Background in aerospace, defense, or another regulated, hardware-driven domain.
